title: Projection-Based Federated Learning on Compact Submanifolds with Geometry-Independent Differential Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2610.33712v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning trains a shared model across clients without exchanging their data, yet the updates they transmit still leak information about individual records. Enforcing differential privacy is harder still when the model parameters lie on a Riemannian manifold. Existing methods rebuild the noise added for privacy in the geometry of each new iterate, aggregate through intrinsic maps that often lack a closed form, and prove convergence only in restricted regimes. We introduce DP-RFedProj, a record-level differentially private federated learning method for compact submanifolds that aggregates through closed-form projections and privatises gradients in a fixed ambient geometry. Each client may run any stochastic first-order optimiser, take several local steps, and participate only intermittently. translated_title: 基于投影的紧致子流形联邦学习与几何无关的差分隐私
translated_abstract: 联邦学习可以在不交换客户端数据的情况下跨客户端训练共享模型，但客户端所传输的更新仍然会泄露关于个体记录的信息。当模型参数位于黎曼流形上时，实施差分隐私则更加困难。现有方法需要在每次新的迭代中根据该迭代所处的几何结构重新构建用于隐私保护的噪声，通过通常缺乏闭式表达的内蕴映射进行聚合，并且仅在受限的情形下才能证明收敛性。我们提出了 DP-RFedProj，这是一种针对紧致子流形的记录级差分隐私联邦学习方法，它通过闭式投影进行聚合，并在固定的环境几何中对梯度进行隐私化处理。每个客户端可以运行任意随机一阶优化器、执行多次本地更新步，并且仅间歇性地参与训练。该方法为整个训练过程提供了显式的记录级 f-DP 保证，且该保证与流形无关、与聚合方案无关……
tldr: 提出了 DP-RFedProj，一种面向紧致子流形的记录级差分隐私联邦学习方法，通过闭式投影进行聚合并在固定环境几何中隐私化梯度，实现了与流形和聚合方案无关的 f-DP 隐私保证。
en_tdlr: DP-RFedProj enables record-level differentially private federated learning on compact submanifolds by aggregating through closed-form projections and privatizing gradients in a fixed ambient geometry, providing f-DP guarantees independent of the manifold and aggregation scheme.
